Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Printed Rustic Wood Effect Horse Wall Art, Black Frame, 40" x 40"
Colors: Black
Materials: Wood
What appears at first glance to be a print on wood is actually on textured paper. This black and white rendering of a handsome equine arrives in a black frame, ready to hang in a horse-lover's room of any style. 40"W x 40"H Print on paper in a frame with a black finish Modern rustic subject and printing effect Ready to hang, all hardware included
